2607.11353.title: Characterising AI Models for Cataloguing
2607.11353.paper_summary: The creation of digital collections involves not only the digitisation of content, but also the creation of catalogue records for it. This often-overlooked task requires slow and costly expert manual work. In this project, we have evaluated the application of AI models to this task, comparing different implementations and models. This work includes a qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the experiments carried out, as well as recommendations on the use of AI models that go beyond the specific use case.
2607.11353.paper_summary_zh: 數位收藏的創建不僅涉及內容的數位化，還包括為其創建目錄記錄。這一常被忽視的任務需要緩慢且昂貴的專業手動工作。在本項目中，我們評估了AI模型在此任務中的應用，並比較了不同的實現和模型。這項工作包括對所進行實驗的定性和定量評估，以及對超越特定用例的AI模型使用的建議。
2607.11353.author: Miguel Arana-Catania et.al.
